description_en: Creates a cross-region traffic scheduling policy for an Enterprise Edition transit router to optimize and control network traffic across regions
description_zh: 如果您需要优化和控制跨区域的网络流量，您可以调用CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy接口创建企业版转发路由器下的跨地域流量调度策略
name: CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the traffic scheduling policy is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建流量调度策略。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建流量调度策略
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router instance
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inter-region connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the traffic scheduling policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流量调度策略的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: traffic_qos_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the traffic scheduling policy.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流量调度策略的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: traffic_qos_policy_description

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth guarantee mode. You can configure QoS queues based on absolute bandwidth values or bandwidth percentages. Valid values:

byBandwidth: configures QoS queues based on absolute bandwidth values.

byBandwidthPercent (default): configures QoS queues based on bandwidth percentages
parameters.help_zh:
带宽保障类型，可以选择按带宽绝对值或者按带宽百分比模式。取值：

byBandwidth：按带宽绝对值模式配置QoS队列。

byBandwidthPercent（默认值）：按带宽百分比模式配置QoS队列
parameters.name: bandwidth_guarantee_mode

fields.help_en:
The absolute bandwidth value that the queue can use for inter-region traffic, in Mbit/s.

A traffic scheduling policy supports up to 10 queues, and each queue can be assigned an absolute bandwidth value.

For example, if you enter 1, traffic that matches the queue can use up to 1 Mbit/s of inter-region bandwidth.

The sum of absolute bandwidth values of all allocated queues in a traffic scheduling policy cannot exceed the inter-region bandwidth value
fields.help_zh:
当前队列可使用的跨地域带宽的绝对值，单位是Mbps。

一个流量调度策略最多支持创建10个队列，每个队列可以被指定允许使用的跨地域带宽。

例如，您输入1，则表示符合当前队列的流量报文最多只能使用1Mbps的跨地域带宽。

一个流量调度策略下，所有已分配队列的跨地域带宽绝对值之和不能超过跨地域带宽的值
fields.name: bandwidth

fields.help_en:
The DSCP values that the queue matches.

A traffic scheduling policy supports up to 3 queues, and each queue can match up to 60 DSCP values. Separate multiple DSCP values with commas (,)
fields.help_zh:
当前队列匹配的DSCP值。

一个流量调度策略最多支持创建3个队列，每个队列最多支持匹配60个DSCP值，DSCP值之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
fields.name: dscps

fields.help_en:
The description of the queue.

A traffic scheduling policy supports up to 10 queues, and each queue can have a description.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
当前队列的描述信息。

一个流量调度策略最多支持创建10个队列，每个队列可以被添加一个队列描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
fields.name: qos_queue_description

fields.help_en:
The name of the queue.

A traffic scheduling policy supports up to 3 queues, and each queue can be assigned a name.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
当前队列的名称。

一个流量调度策略最多支持创建3个队列，每个队列可以被指定一个队列名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
fields.name: qos_queue_name

fields.help_en:
The percentage of inter-region bandwidth that the queue can use.

A traffic scheduling policy supports up to 10 queues, and each queue can be assigned a percentage of inter-region bandwidth.

For example, if you enter 1, traffic that matches the queue can use up to 1% of the inter-region bandwidth.

The sum of bandwidth percentages of all queues in a traffic scheduling policy cannot exceed 100%
fields.help_zh:
当前队列可使用的跨地域带宽的百分比。

一个流量调度策略最多支持创建10个队列，每个队列可以被指定允许使用的跨地域带宽百分比。

例如，您输入1，则表示符合当前队列的流量报文最多只能使用1%的跨地域带宽。

一个流量调度策略下，所有队列的跨地域带宽百分比之和不能超过100%
fields.name: remain_bandwidth_percent

parameters.help_en:
The queue information of the traffic scheduling policy.

You can create up to 3 queues. To create more queues, call CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue
parameters.help_zh:
流量调度策略包含的队列信息。

最多支持创建3个队列，更多队列需要用CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue 创建
parameters.name: traffic_qos_queues

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the cross-region traffic scheduling policy is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建跨地域流量调度策略。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建跨地域流量调度策略
parameters.name: console_dry_run
